features.title: Mission Control live runtime status layer
features.summary: Dashboard now reports real runtime state (services, broker health, policy/manifest load, audit/proof paths, panic, approvals, Hermes connectivity) with explicit PASS/WARN/FAIL badges.

features.title: Client adapter preflight for external agent runtimes
features.summary: Adds a non-privileged preflight proving client runtimes can reach and use the SlimyOS broker safely, while confirming dangerous/raw-shell paths remain blocked or gated.

features.title: SlimyOS MCP stdio bridge
features.summary: Strict MCP/JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio bridge compatible with Claude Desktop. stdout is protocol-only, logs go to stderr. Supports initialize, ping, notifications/initialized, tools/list, tools/call. No extra keys in responses. Fails closed when broker unavailable.

features.title: MCP doctor dry-run and healthline
features.summary: Adds operator-facing MCP doctor and one-line healthline checks that produce proof artifacts, detect client wiring readiness, and validate blocked/gated policy evidence without mutating user config by default.

features.title: Safe MCP client config apply and rollback
features.summary: Adds safe client config installer with dry-run, --apply (with timestamped backup and JSON validation), --rollback, --status, and --write-snippets modes. Supported: Claude Desktop (merge mcpServers). Unsupported clients stay MANUAL_REQUIRED, not FAIL. Real Claude Desktop install verified.

features.title: Claude Desktop MCP post-install verification
features.summary: Post-install verifier that reads real Claude Desktop config, confirms SlimyOS entry, validates launcher, runs live MCP checks (initialize, tools/list, safe/blocked/gated calls), checks broker health, redacts secrets, and generates proof artifacts. Read-only, no mutation.

features.title: Real Claude Desktop GUI MCP use verified via audit proof pack
features.summary: Inspects SlimyOS audit logs for evidence of Claude Desktop GUI tool calls. Supports --recent and --watch modes. Detects explicit claude-desktop agent identity, verifies policy-enforced list_directory with allowed disposition, confirms no file mutations and no unsafe actions. Generates comprehensive proof artifacts. Does not read chats or automate GUI.

features.title: First-class client identity and session visibility in SlimyOS
features.summary: Adds client identity envelope (client_id, client_name, client_kind, transport) to all tool calls. MCP bridge tags calls with identity metadata. Audit logger enriches events with client identity. Dashboard shows Recent Client Activity panel with disposition badges, policy rules, and safety flags. Runtime API exposes recent_client_activity, clients_seen, and last_claude_desktop_event. Privacy rule: no chat text stored.

features.title: Approval request visibility and decision recording in Mission Control
features.summary: Adds first-class approval request tracking in Tool Broker and Mission Control. Gated tool calls now return approval_id, create audited pending approvals with redacted args and client identity, and expose approval state via API/UI. Approve/deny decisions are recorded safely without executing destructive actions yet.

features.title: Approved execution support in safe disposable test lane
features.summary: Adds explicit execute-approved flow with strict one-time approval_id checks, args snapshot matching, allowlisted tool enforcement, and path-lane safety gates. Only git_commit is executable and only inside disposable /tmp proof lanes. Mission Control now surfaces execution status and test-lane execute controls. Real project repos remain non-executable through this path.

features.title: Real Claude Desktop gated approval pending-card proof
features.summary: Adds prepare/watch proof workflow that verifies a real Claude Desktop MCP gated tool request returns approval_required, creates a pending approval with explicit Claude Desktop identity, and appears in Mission Control/API without executing the request. Includes identity-normalization fix for legacy Claude Desktop aliases (`claude-desktop` -> `claude_desktop`, transport `mcp_stdio`) so approval records propagate stable identity fields. Enforces privacy (no chat text, secret redaction) and real-repo no-mutation checks.
